tools.name: Ø10 mm straight Z2, 1-1/4″ cut (Freud 04-520)
tools.notes: Freud 04-520 double-flute straight router bit, carbide (solid carbide). Cutting length 31.75 mm (1-1/4″), overall length 60.33 mm, shank 6.35 mm. A hand-router bit; fine for light CNC work with shallow passes. From Freud's 2020 General Purpose catalog; feeds and speeds are conservative starting values, not Freud's. Same bit also listed as 12-520 (shank 12.7 mm).
